g.text: name: design-postgres-tables description: | Use this skill
Design PostgreSQL tables, schemas, or data models when
creating new tables and when modifying existing ones.

Create user tables, order tables, reference tables, or
Understand PostgreSQL best practices for normalization,
Design update-heavy, upsert-heavy, or OLTP-style tables
PostgreSQL schema, table design, data types,
PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY, indexes, B-tree, GIN, JSONB,
Comprehensive reference covering data types, indexing
